title: Skywatcher sees orange orbs over Picatinny Arsenal during the New Jersey drone wave

tellings.quote: So that being said, we show up in New Jersey first night on location within 30 minutes over Pikatin Arsenal. Wopw all these orange orbs come into existence right over Pikatini Arsenal.

plain: Jake Barber, a former military helicopter pilot who says he once flew a recovered UFO, says that during the 2024 wave of drone and light sightings over New Jersey, his team arrived on location and within 30 minutes on the first night "all these orange orbs" appeared right over Picatinny Arsenal, an Army research base. He tells Michels he saw it himself, and if true it would put the unexplained lights over a sensitive military site.
